QuestInfo.name: [Beasts of Fury] Choosing Sides
QuestInfo.0: The senior apprentice of each faction in Mu Lung will give you an entry exam. Talk to them for your chance to join.
QuestInfo.1: The head senior apprentices are accepting applications. They seem to bicker quite a bit, but in a friendly manner.\r\n#rThink about which faction you would like to join, the Gold Dragons or the Red Tigers.#k
QuestInfo.2: After much consideration, you've chosen your faction. They said your choice is permanent. Hope it was the right one!
